title.zh: 关税（海关罚单通知）条例 2012

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 2 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Customs (Customs Ticket Notices) Regulations 2012 and shall come into operation on 1st January 2013.

heading.en: Offences prescribed for section 125A of Act

text.en: 2. The offences to which section 125A of the Act applies are set out in the First Schedule.

3. A notice to be served on any person under section 125A of the Act shall be in the form set out in the Second Schedule.
[S 186/2019 wef 01/04/2019]

FIRST SCHEDULE
Regulation 2
Offences prescribed under section 125A of Act
First column
Second column
Provision
Description of offence
1.Section 136(1) of the Act
Any person, being in charge of a motor vehicle registered under the Road Traffic Act (Cap. 276), who leaves or attempts to leave Singapore in that motor vehicle, or with that motor vehicle in a vessel, without such minimum amount of motor fuel in such of its fuel supply tanks as the Minister may by order prescribe.
